headline: Nokia Lowers Cash-Flow Target Despite Profit Rise
summary: Nokia reduced its 2026 cash-flow conversion assumption despite reporting a 35% increase in comparable profit and sales growth.
why: Nokia is a major global telecommunications equipment manufacturer undergoing strategic shifts toward enterprise and AI sales.

impacts.name: Nokia
impacts.why: Lowered cash-flow assumptions weigh on sentiment despite higher comparable profits.

why_moved: The company reduced its 2026 cash-flow conversion assumption, offsetting positive profit figures.
